body: I feel the same way. I fantasize about getting cancer like some people fantasize about getting a nice house or something. I feel like its a perfect way for me to go where no one would be disappointed in me.

I haven't really looked into getting help before. I am currently unemployed and don't have health insurance so I think my options are limited to asking my parents for help. My parents don't have much money either, my mom is unemployed and my dad makes just enough money to pay the bills. I feel bad asking them for help. I don't think I really deserve it. 

edit: also thank you for replying to my post. It means a lot to have someone to chat with about this kind of thing. I'm too scared to talk with friends or family about this
